```{r}
library(tidyverse)

```

```{r readdata, echo = F, include = F}
# load data set
empro <- here::here("data", "EMPRO_data_20260506.RData")
load(empro)

#make enrollment month factor 
empro_data$enrollment_month1 = factor(empro_data$enrollment_month)

#make new variable for yes/no CRPC
empro_data$crpc_per = empro_data$cohort_empro != "mHSPC"

# add variable for not matched
empro_data$not_matched = ifelse(empro_data$subject %in% not_matched, 1, 0)

#relabel new vars
var_label(empro_data) <- list(
  crpc_per = "CRPC (vs. mHSPC)", 
  enrollment_month1 = "Study visit at entry")

# read in site-level data
site_data <- read.csv("H:/GU/EMPRO/Randomization/randscheme_final.csv") %>% 
  rename(site_country = Country,
         site_timetodx = timetodx,
         site_crpc = CRPC)

# analysis data set (remove exclusions)
analysis_data <- empro_data %>% 
  filter(!is.na(empro_cnstdate) & enrollment_month<=45 & !is.na(cohort_empro)) %>%
  mutate(enrollment_month1 = fct_drop(enrollment_month1),
         site = ifelse(site=="University of Virgina (UVA)", "University of Virginia (UVA)",
                       site),
         sitenew = case_when(
           site=="Cross Cancer Institute (Alberta Health Services)" ~ "Cross Cancer Institute",
           site=="Guys St. Thomas NHS Foundation Trust" ~ "Guys and St. Thomas NHS Foundation Trust",
           site=="Royal Brisbane & Women's Hospital" ~ "Queensland University of Technology",
           site=="St. Vincent’s Hospital Sydney" ~ "St. Vincent's Hospital Sydney",
           site=="University of Virginia (UVA)" ~ "University of Virginia", 
           site=="NewYork-Presbyterian Brooklyn Methodist Hospital" ~ "Weill Cornell Medical Center",
           TRUE ~ site),
         site_short = ifelse(sitenew=="NewYork-Presbyterian Brooklyn Methodist Hospital",
                             "Weill Cornell Medical Center",
                             sitenew),
         site_short = fct_recode(
           factor(sitenew),
           "Cross Cancer Institute" = "Cross Cancer Institute",
           "Duke Cancer Center" = "Duke Comprehensive Cancer Center",
           "Eastern Health" = "Eastern Health",
           "Guys and St. Thomas" = "Guys and St. Thomas NHS Foundation Trust",
           "Lancashire Teaching Hospitals" = "Lancashire Teaching Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust",
           "Macquarie Hospital" = "Macquarie University Hospital",
           "MSK Cancer Center" = "Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center",
           "Ottawa Cancer Centre" = "Ottawa Hospital Cancer Centre",
           "St Vincent's Sydney" = "St. Vincent's Hospital Sydney",
           "Royal Marsden" = "The Royal Marsden NHS Foundation Trust",
           "University Hospital Southampton" = "University Hospital Southampton NHS Foundation Trust",
           "University of Virginia" = "University of Virginia",
           "Weill Cornell" = "Weill Cornell Medical Center",
           "Queensland Univ. of Tech."="Queensland University of Technology",),
         ecog3 = replace_na(ecog2, "Unknown")) %>% 
  left_join(site_data, by = c("sitenew"="sitegp")) %>% 
  mutate(# re-order - this matches the order from when they were randomized (must match constrained space file)
    sitenew = factor(sitenew,
                           levels = c("Queensland University of Technology",
                                      "Eastern Health",
                                      "St. Vincent's Hospital Sydney",
                                      "Macquarie University Hospital",
                                      "Cross Cancer Institute",
                                      "Ottawa Hospital Cancer Centre",
                                      "The Royal Marsden NHS Foundation Trust",
                                      "Lancashire Teaching Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust",
                                      "Guys and St. Thomas NHS Foundation Trust",
                                      "University Hospital Southampton NHS Foundation Trust",
                                      "Duke Comprehensive Cancer Center",
                                      "Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center",
                                      "Weill Cornell Medical Center",
                                      "University of Virginia")),
    eortc_0_log = log(max(eortc_0, na.rm=TRUE) + 1 - eortc_0)) %>% 
  # append n to site
  group_by(sitenew) %>% 
  mutate(n_site = n()) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(site_n = paste0(site, "\n(n=", n_site, ")")) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  # append n to site
  mutate(siteshort_n = paste0(site_short, "\n(n=", n_site, ")")) %>% 
  set_variable_labels(ecog3="ECOG",
                      enrollment_month1 = "Study visit at entry")

# patient counts
n_crpc <- analysis_data %>% filter(cohort_empro=="CRPC" & arm=="intervention") %>% nrow()
n_mhspc <- analysis_data %>% filter(cohort_empro=="mHSPC" & arm=="intervention") %>% nrow()
n_intervention <- analysis_data %>% filter(arm=="intervention") %>% nrow()

```

# Enrollment

## By site

```{r, fig.width = 10, fig.height = 6}
# enrollment by site

analysis_data %>% 
  filter(arm=="intervention") %>% 
  group_by(site_short, site_country) %>% 
  summarize(n = n()) %>% 
  ggplot() +
  geom_bar(width=.75,
           stat="identity",
           aes(x=reorder(site_short,n), y=n, fill=site_country)) +
 geom_text(
    aes(x = reorder(site_short, n), y = n, label = n),
    hjust = -0.2,
    size = 5,
    color = "black",
    fontface = "bold") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(x = NULL,
       y = "Number Enrolled",
       title = "Enrollment by Site",
       fill = NULL) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("Australia" = "#c2a5cf", 
               "Canada" = "#7b3294", 
               "U.K." = "#a6dba0", 
               "U.S." = "#008837"),
    drop = FALSE
  ) +
  theme_bw() +  
  guides(fill = guide_legend(ncol = 4)) +
  theme_bw() +  
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size=18, hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
        legend.text = element_text(colour="black", size = 14),
        legend.title = element_text(colour="black", size = 14),
        legend.position = "bottom", 
        axis.title.x = element_text(vjust=0.5,face="bold", size=16),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size=12),
        axis.title.y = element_text(angle=90, vjust=0.70, face="bold", size=18),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size=12)) 

```

## By date

```{r}
# enrollment over time
analysis_data %>% 
  filter(arm=="intervention") %>% 
  mutate(quarter = floor_date(empro_cnstdate, unit = "quarter")) %>% 
  count(quarter) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = quarter, y = n)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#008837", width = 80) +
  scale_x_date(
    labels = function(x) {
      paste0(format(x, "%Y"), "\n Q", lubridate::quarter(x))
    },
    date_breaks = "6 months"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Quarter",
    y = "Count",
    title = "Enrollments by Calendar Quarter") +
  theme_bw() +  
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size=18, hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
        axis.title.x = element_text(vjust=0.5,face="bold", size=16),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size=14),
        axis.title.y = element_text(face="bold", size=16),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size=14))  

# cumulative
# enrollment over time
analysis_data %>% 
  filter(arm=="intervention") %>% 
  mutate(month = floor_date(empro_cnstdate, unit = "month")) %>% 
  count(month) %>% 
  arrange(month) %>% 
  mutate(cum_n = cumsum(n)) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = month, y = cum_n)) +
  geom_line(color = "#008837", linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_point(color = "#008837", size = 3) +
  labs(
    x = "Month",
    y = "Cumulative Enrollments",
    title = "Cumulative Enrollments Over Time") +
  scale_x_date(
    date_labels = "%b\n%Y",   # Jan 2024, Feb 2024, etc.
    date_breaks = "6 months"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +  
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size=18, hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
        axis.title.x = element_text(vjust=0.5,face="bold", size=16),
        axis.text.x = element_text(hjust = 1,size=14),
        axis.title.y = element_text(face="bold", size=16),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size=14))  

```

```{r, fig.width = 10, fig.height = 6}
# enrollment by site - both arms
analysis_data %>% 
  group_by(site_country, arm) %>% 
  summarize(n = n(),
            p = n/n_intervention*100) %>% 
  mutate(arm = str_to_title(arm)) %>% 
  ggplot() +
  geom_bar(width=.75,
           stat="identity",
           aes(x=reorder(site_country,n), y=n),
           fill="#008837") +
  geom_text(
    aes(x = site_country, y = n, label = n),
    vjust = -0.2,
    size = 5,
    color = "black",
    fontface = "bold") +
  labs(x = NULL,
       y = "Number Enrolled",
       title = "Enrollment by Country by Arm") +
  theme_bw() +  
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size=18, hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
        axis.title.x = element_text(vjust=0.5,face="bold", size=16),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size=14),
        axis.title.y = element_text(angle=90, vjust=0.70, face="bold", size=18),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size=14),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 14)) +
  facet_wrap(~arm)
```

## Patient characteristics



### Intervention arm

```{r}
analysis_data %>%
  filter(arm_c=="Intervention") %>% 
  mutate(site_short = fct_drop(site_short)) %>% 
  dplyr::select(site_short,
         age_baseline,
         race_gp,
         year_emp_enrollment,
         enrollment_month_gp,
         crpc_per,
         educ_gp) %>% 
  tbl_summary(by = site_short,
              missing = "ifany",
              missing_text = "N missing",
              type = all_continuous() ~ "continuous2",
              statistic = all_continuous() ~ c("{median} ({p25}, {p75})",
                                               "{min}, {max}")) %>%
  bold_labels() 

```

#### Age

```{r}
ggplot(analysis_data %>% filter(arm=="intervention"), aes(x = site_short, y = age_baseline)) +
  geom_boxplot(fill = "#a6dba0") +
  xlab("Site") +
  ylab("Age") +
  labs(title = "Intervention") +
  coord_flip() +
  theme_bw() +  
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size=18, hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
        axis.title.x = element_text(vjust=0.5,face="bold", size=16),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size=12),
        axis.title.y = element_text(angle=90, vjust=0.70, face="bold", size=18),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size=12),

        legend.title = element_text(colour="black", size = 14))
```

# Trigger activity & Clinical Response

## Questionnaire completion

### Overall

```{r}
# line graph of survey completion by month
triggers_long %>% 
  filter(subject %in% analysis_data$subject) %>% 
  group_by(visit) %>% 
  summarize(n_visit = n(),
         p_visit = n_visit/n_intervention*100,
         month = gsub("Month ", "", visit), 
         month = factor(month, levels = 1:12, labels = paste0(1:12))) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x=month, y=p_visit, group = 1)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 2) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  labs(x = "Month",
       y = "Percentage of Participants",
       fill = NULL,
       title = "Percentage of Participants Completing \nthe EMPRO Survey at Each Visit") +
  theme_bw() +  
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size=18, hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
        axis.title.x = element_text(vjust=0.5,face="bold", size=16),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size=14),
        axis.title.y = element_text(angle=90, vjust=0.70, face="bold", size=18),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size=14)) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 85))
  
```


### Completion of EMPRO - hypothesis
```{r}
# At least 75% of patients will complete at least 66% of EMPRO PROMs questions during 6 months of follow up
n_complete<-triggers_long %>% 
  mutate(month = as.numeric(gsub("Month ", "", visit))) %>% 
  filter(subject %in% analysis_data$subject & month<=6) %>% 
  nrow()
n_intervention <- analysis_data %>% filter(arm=="intervention") %>% nrow()
```
There were `r n_complete` surveys completed across `r n_intervention` participants over 6 months, for a completion rate of `r round(100*n_complete/(n_intervention*6), 1)`

### By site

```{r, fig.height = 7, fig.width =12}
# line graph of survey completion per month by site
triggers_long %>% 
  group_by(subject, visit) %>% 
  slice(1) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(site = ifelse(site=="NewYork-Presbyterian Brooklyn Methodist Hospital", 
                       "Weill Cornell Medical Center",
                       site)) %>% 
  inner_join(analysis_data %>% 
               mutate(site = ifelse(site=="NewYork-Presbyterian Brooklyn Methodist Hospital", 
                       "Weill Cornell Medical Center",
                       site)) %>% 
               count(site, name = "n_site"), by = "site") %>% 
  group_by(visit, site, n_site) %>% 
  summarize(n_visit = n(), .drop=TRUE) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(p_visit = n_visit/n_site*100,
         month = gsub("Month ", "", visit), 
         month = factor(month, levels = 1:12, labels = paste0(1:12)),
         site_short = fct_recode(
           factor(site),
           "Cross Cancer Institute" = "Cross Cancer Institute (Alberta Health Services)",
           "Duke Cancer Center" = "Duke Comprehensive Cancer Center",
           "Eastern Health" = "Eastern Health",
           "Guy’s St Thomas’" = "Guys St. Thomas NHS Foundation Trust",

           "Macquarie Hospital" = "Macquarie University Hospital",
           "MSK Cancer Center" = "Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center",
           "Ottawa Cancer Centre" = "Ottawa Hospital Cancer Centre",
           "Queensland Univ. of Tech" = "Queensland University of Technology",
           "RBWH" = "Royal Brisbane & Women's Hospital",
           "St Vincent’s Sydney" = "St. Vincent's Hospital Sydney",
           "Royal Marsden" = "The Royal Marsden NHS Foundation Trust",
           "University Hospital Southampton" = "University Hospital Southampton NHS Foundation Trust",
           "University of Virginia" = "University of Virgina (UVA)",
           "Weill Cornell" = "Weill Cornell Medical Center"
         ),
        site_short = paste0(site_short, "\n(N=", n_site, ")"),
```

## Soft triggers

```{r}
# overview of number of surveys completed and their outcome wrt soft triggers - stacked bar graph
triggers_long %>% 
  group_by(visit) %>% 
  mutate(n_visit = n()) %>% 
  ungroup %>% 
  mutate(response = case_when(
    soft_trigger == "No" & self_mgmt=="No" ~ 1,
    soft_trigger == "No" & self_mgmt=="Yes" ~ 2,
    soft_trigger == "Yes" & self_mgmt=="No" ~ 3,
    soft_trigger == "Yes" & self_mgmt=="Yes" ~ 4
  )) %>% 
  group_by(visit, response, n_visit) %>% 
  summarize(n_freq = n()) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(p_freq = n_freq/n_intervention * 100,
         response = factor(response, 
                           levels = 1:4,
                           labels = c("No soft trigger; did not access content",
                                      "No soft trigger; accessed content",
                                      "Soft trigger; did not access content",
                                      "Soft trigger; accessed content")),
         month = gsub("Month ", "", visit), 
         month = factor(month, levels = 1:12, labels = paste0(1:12))) %>% 
  ggplot() +
  geom_bar(width=.75,
           stat="identity", position=position_stack(reverse = TRUE),
           aes(x=month, y=p_freq, fill=response)) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("No soft trigger; did not access content" = "#c2a5cf", 
               "No soft trigger; accessed content" = "#7b3294", 
               "Soft trigger; did not access content" = "#a6dba0", 
               "Soft trigger; accessed content" = "#008837"),
    #limits = c("1", "2", "3"),
    drop = FALSE
  ) +
  labs(x = "Month",
       y = "Percentage of Participants",
       fill = NULL,
       title = "Soft Trigger Response at Each Month\nAmong All Participants") +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(ncol = 2)) +
  theme_bw() +  
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size=18, hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
        legend.text = element_text(colour="black", size = 14),
        legend.title = element_text(colour="black", size = 14),
        legend.position = "bottom", 
        #legend.position.inside = c(0.8, 0.2),
        axis.title.x = element_text(vjust=0.5,face="bold", size=16),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size=14),
        axis.title.y = element_text(angle=90, vjust=0.70, face="bold", size=18),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size=14))
```

### Domains

```{r}
# heat map showing frequency of soft triggers for each domain 
triggers_domain_soft <- triggers_long %>%
  group_by(visit) %>% 
  mutate(n_visit = n()) %>% 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(
      soft_anxious,
      soft_discouraged,
      soft_fatigue,
      soft_general_pain,
      soft_insomnia,
      soft_joint_pain,
      soft_sad,
      soft_social_isolation
    ),
    names_to = "domain",
    values_to = "trigger"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    domain = factor(
      domain,
      levels = c(
        "soft_anxious",
        "soft_sad",
        "soft_discouraged",
        "soft_social_isolation",
        "soft_fatigue",
        "soft_insomnia",
        "soft_general_pain",
        "soft_joint_pain"),
      labels = c("Anxious", "Sad", "Discouraged", "Social isolation", "Fatigue", "Insomnia", "General pain", "Joint pain"))) %>% 
  group_by(visit, domain, n_visit) %>% 
  reframe(n_triggered = sum(trigger=="Yes", na.rm=TRUE),
            prop_triggered = n_triggered/n_visit) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  mutate(month = gsub("Month ", "", visit), 
         month = factor(month, levels = 1:12, labels = paste0(1:12))) %>% 
  group_by(domain) %>%
  mutate(domain_mean = mean(prop_triggered, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(domain = forcats::fct_reorder(domain, domain_mean))
```

```{r}
# frequency of each soft trigger domain - ever for each patient
triggers_long %>% 
  group_by(subject) %>% 
  summarize(any_anxious = max(as.numeric(soft_anxious)) - 1,
        any_sad = max(as.numeric(soft_sad)) - 1,
        any_discouraged = max(as.numeric(soft_discouraged)) - 1,
        any_social_isolation = max(as.numeric(soft_social_isolation)) - 1,
        any_fatigue = max(as.numeric(soft_fatigue)) - 1,
        any_insomnia = max(as.numeric(soft_insomnia)) - 1,
        any_general_pain = max(as.numeric(soft_general_pain)) - 1,
        any_joint_pain = max(as.numeric(soft_joint_pain)) - 1) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  summarize(any_anxious = sum(any_anxious),
            any_sad = sum(any_sad),
            any_discouraged = sum(any_discouraged),
            any_social_isolation = sum(any_social_isolation),
            any_fatigue = sum(any_fatigue),
            any_insomnia = sum(any_insomnia),
            any_general_pain = sum(any_general_pain),
            any_joint_pain = sum(any_joint_pain)) %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = everything(), names_to = "domain", values_to = "freq") %>% 
  mutate(p_freq = freq/n_intervention*100,
             domain = factor(
      domain,
      levels = c(
        "any_sad",
        "any_fatigue",
        "any_insomnia",
        "any_anxious",
        "any_joint_pain",
        "any_general_pain",
        "any_discouraged",
        "any_social_isolation"),
      labels = c("Sad", "Fatigue", "Insomnia", "Anxious", "Joint pain", "General pain", "Discouraged", "Social isolation"))) %>% 
  ggplot() +
  geom_bar(width=.75,
           stat="identity",
           aes(x=reorder(domain, p_freq), y=p_freq),
           fill="#008837") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(x = "Domain",
       y = "Percentage of Participants",
       fill = NULL,
       title = "Proportion of Participants Ever \nHaving a Soft Trigger for Each Domain") +
  ylim(0, 80) +
  theme_bw() +  
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size=18, hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
        axis.title.x = element_text(vjust=0.5,face="bold", size=16),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size=14),
        axis.title.y = element_text(angle=90, vjust=0.70, face="bold", size=18),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size=14))
```

```{r}
# self management
# overview of number of surveys completed and their outcome wrt hard triggers - stacked bar graph
triggers_long %>% 
  group_by(visit) %>% 
  mutate(n_visit = n()) %>% 
  ungroup %>% 
  mutate(response = case_when(
    hard_trigger == "No" & self_mgmt=="No" ~ 1,
    hard_trigger == "No" & self_mgmt=="Yes" ~ 2,
    hard_trigger == "Yes" & self_mgmt=="No" ~ 3,
    hard_trigger == "Yes" & self_mgmt=="Yes" ~ 4
  )) %>% 
  group_by(visit, response, n_visit) %>% 
  summarize(n_freq = n()) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(p_freq = n_freq/n_intervention * 100,
         response = factor(response, 
                           levels = 1:4,
                           labels = c("No hard trigger; did not access content",
                                      "No hard trigger; accessed content",
                                      "Hard trigger; did not access content",
                                      "Hard trigger; accessed content")),
         month = gsub("Month ", "", visit), 
         month = factor(month, levels = 1:12, labels = paste0(1:12))) %>% 
  ggplot() +
  geom_bar(width=.75,
           stat="identity", position=position_stack(reverse = TRUE),
           aes(x=month, y=p_freq, fill=response)) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("No hard trigger; did not access content" = "#c2a5cf", 
               "No hard trigger; accessed content" = "#7b3294", 
               "Hard trigger; did not access content" = "#a6dba0", 
               "Hard trigger; accessed content" = "#008837"),
    #limits = c("1", "2", "3"),
    drop = FALSE
  ) +
  labs(x = "Month",
       y = "Percentage of Participants",
       fill = NULL,
       title = "Hard Trigger Response at Each Month\nAmong All Participants") +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(ncol = 2)) +
  theme_bw() +  
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size=18, hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
        legend.text = element_text(colour="black", size = 14),
        legend.title = element_text(colour="black", size = 14),
        legend.position = "bottom", 
        #legend.position.inside = c(0.8, 0.2),
        axis.title.x = element_text(vjust=0.5,face="bold", size=16),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size=14),
        axis.title.y = element_text(angle=90, vjust=0.70, face="bold", size=18),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size=14))
```

### Clinician intervention

```{r}
# intervention report completion rates and timeliness (within 48 business hours)
# stacked bar graph of proportion that completed report within 48 business hours and >48 hours
# out of those with hard triggers, at each time point

# don't count weekends 
create.calendar(
  name = "weekdays",
  weekdays = c("saturday", "sunday")
)

triggers_long %>% 
  filter(hard_trigger=="Yes" & clinician_status!="Not Applicable") %>% 
  group_by(visit) %>% 
  mutate(n_hard = n(),
         n_response = sum(clinician_status=="Completed")) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(
    empro_time = as.POSIXct(EMPRO_questionnaire_completion_date,
                            format = "%d-%b-%Y %H:%M:%S",
                            tz = "UTC"),
    
    clinician_time = as.POSIXct(clinician_survey_completion_date,
                                format = "%d-%b-%Y %H:%M:%S",
                                tz = "UTC"),
    deadline = as.POSIXct(
      add.bizdays(as.Date(empro_time), 2, "weekdays"),
      tz = "UTC"),
    response = case_when(
      clinician_status=="Completed" & delayed_by_holiday=="TRUE" ~ 1,
      clinician_status=="Completed" & 
        clinician_time >= empro_time &
        clinician_time <= deadline  ~ 1,
      clinician_status=="Completed" ~ 2,
      TRUE ~ 3
    )) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(response)) %>% 
  group_by(visit, response, n_hard) %>% 
  summarize(n_freq = n()) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(p_freq = n_freq/n_hard * 100,
         response = factor(response, 
                           levels = 1:3,
                           labels = c("Within 48 hours",
                                      "After 48 hours",
                                      "Missed response")),
         month = gsub("Month ", "", visit), 
         month = factor(month, levels = 1:12, labels = paste0(1:12))) %>% 
  ggplot() +
  geom_bar(width=.75,
           stat="identity", position=position_stack(reverse = TRUE),
           aes(x=month, y=p_freq, fill=response)) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("#c2a5cf", 
               "#7b3294",
               "grey60") ) +
  labs(x = "Month",
       y = "Percentage of Participants",
       fill = NULL,
       title = "Hard Trigger Intervention at Each Month\n Among Participants with Hard Triggers") +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(ncol = 3)) +
  theme_bw() +  
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size=18, hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
        legend.text = element_text(colour="black", size = 14),
        legend.title = element_text(colour="black", size = 14),
        legend.position = "bottom", 
        #legend.position.inside = c(0.8, 0.2),
        axis.title.x = element_text(vjust=0.5,face="bold", size=16),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size=14),
        axis.title.y = element_text(angle=90, vjust=0.70, face="bold", size=18),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size=14)) 
```

### Persistent hard triggers

```{r}
n_persistent_triggers <- triggers_long %>% 
  filter(!is.na(opted_out_domains)) %>% 
  nrow()
n_persistent_people <- triggers_long %>% 
  filter(!is.na(opted_out_domains)) %>% 
  distinct(subject) %>% 
  nrow()
n_persistent_general_pain <- triggers_long %>% 
  filter(grepl("general_pain", opted_out_domains)) %>% 
  nrow()
n_persistent_fatigue <- triggers_long %>% 
  filter(grepl("fatigue", opted_out_domains)) %>% 
  nrow()
n_persistent_insomnia <- triggers_long %>% 
  filter(grepl("insomnia", opted_out_domains)) %>% 
  nrow()
n_persistent_joint_pain <- triggers_long %>% 
  filter(grepl("joint_pain", opted_out_domains)) %>% 
  nrow()
n_persistent_social_isolation <- triggers_long %>% 
  filter(grepl("social_isolation", opted_out_domains)) %>% 
  nrow()

# number of patients eligible for persistent hard trigger opt out

persist <- triggers_long %>%
  mutate(month = gsub("Month ", "", visit), 
         month = factor(month, levels = 1:12, labels = paste0(1:12))) %>% 
  arrange(subject, month) %>%   # ensure correct order
  group_by(subject) %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      starts_with("hard_"),
      ~ (. == "Yes" &
         dplyr::lag(. , 1) == "Yes" &
         dplyr::lag(. , 2) == "Yes"),
      .names = "{.col}_3inrow"
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

persist %>% 
  select(ends_with("_3inrow")) %>% 
  select(-hard_trigger_domains_3inrow, -hard_trigger_3inrow) %>% 
  tbl_summary()

```

There were `r n_persistent_triggers` where `r n_persistent_people` participants opted out of persistent hard triggers. This included `r n_persistent_general_pain` general pain, `r n_persistent_joint_pain` joint pain, `r n_persistent_fatigue` fatigue, `r n_persistent_insomnia` insomnia, and `r n_persistent_social_isolation` social isolation.

```{r}
# frequency of each soft trigger domain - ever for each patient
soft_domains <- triggers_long %>% 
  left_join(analysis_data %>% select(subject, cohort_empro), by="subject") %>% 
  group_by(subject, cohort_empro) %>% 
  summarize(any_anxious = max(as.numeric(soft_anxious)) - 1,
        any_sad = max(as.numeric(soft_sad)) - 1,
        any_discouraged = max(as.numeric(soft_discouraged)) - 1,
        any_social_isolation = max(as.numeric(soft_social_isolation)) - 1,
        any_fatigue = max(as.numeric(soft_fatigue)) - 1,
        any_insomnia = max(as.numeric(soft_insomnia)) - 1,
        any_general_pain = max(as.numeric(soft_general_pain)) - 1,
        any_joint_pain = max(as.numeric(soft_joint_pain)) - 1) %>% 
  group_by(cohort_empro) %>% 
  summarize(any_anxious = sum(any_anxious),
            any_sad = sum(any_sad),
            any_discouraged = sum(any_discouraged),
            any_social_isolation = sum(any_social_isolation),
```

```{r, fig.width = 10, fig.height = 6}
  distinct() %>% 
  mutate(p_freq = n_access/n_soft * 100,
         month = gsub("Month ", "", visit), 
         month = factor(month, levels = 1:12, labels = paste0(1:12))) %>% 
  ggplot() +
  geom_bar(width=.75, stat="identity",
           aes(x=month, y=p_freq), fill="#008837") +
  labs(x = "Month",
       y = "Percentage of Participants",
       fill = NULL,
       title = "Self-Management Utilization at Each Month\n Among Participants with Soft Triggers") +
  theme_bw() +  
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size=18, hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
        axis.title.x = element_text(vjust=0.5,face="bold", size=16),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size=14),
        axis.title.y = element_text(angle=90, vjust=0.70, face="bold", size=18),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size=14),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 14)) +
  facet_wrap(.~after_bug)

```

# IRONMAN PROM completion rates

## Completion of EORTC

EORTC QLQ-C30 composite score can be calculated as long as at least half of the items on the given scale have valid, non-missing item responses. Partially completed questionnaires with at least half of the items completed are counted as complete.

```{r}

fig_data <- analysis_data %>%
  select(subject, arm, starts_with("percent_eortc_complete")) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("percent_eortc_complete"),
               names_to = "time",
               names_prefix = "percent_eortc_complete_",
               values_to = "complete") %>%
  left_join(analysis_data %>%
              select(subject, starts_with("completed_month")) %>%
              pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("completed_month"),
                           names_to = "time",
                           names_prefix = "completed_month_",
                           values_to = "completed_month"),
            by=c("subject", "time")) %>%
  mutate_at(vars(starts_with("complete")), ~replace_na(.,0)) %>%
  # last completed EORTC questionnaire (fill in for participants with missing visits in cyc_date)
  mutate(temp = as.numeric(ifelse(complete>0, time, NA)),
         temp = ifelse(time==0 & is.na(temp), -1, temp)) %>%
  group_by(subject) %>%
  mutate(last_complete = max(temp, na.rm=TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  # categorize missing pattern
  mutate(missing = case_when(
    completed_month==2 ~ 4,
    completed_month==3 ~ 5,
    (complete==0 & completed_month==1) | (complete==0 & as.numeric(time) <= last_complete) ~ 3,
    complete==0 & as.numeric(time) > last_complete  ~ 3,
    complete>0 & complete<50 ~ 2,
    complete>=50 ~ 1),
    missing = factor(missing, levels = 1:5, labels=c("EORTC completed", 
                                                     "EORTC partially completed",
                                                     "EORTC not completed", 
                                                     "Withdrew from study",
                                                     "Deceased")),
         time = factor(time, levels=seq(0,12,3))) %>%
  group_by(time, missing, arm) %>%
  summarize(n =n()) %>% 
  mutate(p = n/n_intervention*100,
         arm = str_to_title(arm))

fig_data %>%
  ggplot() +
  geom_bar(width=.75,
         stat="identity", position=position_stack(reverse = TRUE),
         aes(x=time, y=p, fill=missing)) +
  scale_fill_manual(name = "", values = c("#0868ac", "#43a2ca", "#7bccc4", "grey40", "grey20")) +
  labs(x = "Month",
       y = "Percentage of Participants",
       fill = NULL,
       title = "EORTC QLQ-C30 Questionnaire Completion") +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(ncol = 2)) +
  theme_bw() +  
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size=18, hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
        legend.text = element_text(colour="black", size = 14),
        legend.title = element_text(colour="black", size = 14),
        legend.position = "bottom", 
        #legend.position.inside = c(0.8, 0.2),
        axis.title.x = element_text(vjust=0.5,face="bold", size=16),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size=14),
        axis.title.y = element_text(angle=90, vjust=0.70, face="bold", size=18),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size=14),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 14)) +
  facet_wrap(.~arm)

fig_data %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x=time, y=p, group = missing, color=missing)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.5) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  labs(x = "Month",
       y = "Percentage of Participants",
       color = NULL,
       title = "EORTC QLQ-C30 Questionnaire Completion") +
  guides(color = guide_legend(ncol = 2)) +
  theme_bw() +  
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size=18, hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
        legend.text = element_text(colour="black", size = 14),
        legend.title = element_text(colour="black", size = 14),
        legend.position = "bottom", 
        axis.title.x = element_text(vjust=0.5,face="bold", size=16),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size=14),
        axis.title.y = element_text(angle=90, vjust=0.70, face="bold", size=18),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size=14),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 14)) +  
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#0868ac", "#43a2ca", "#7bccc4", "grey40", "grey20")) +
  facet_wrap(.~arm)

  
```

### By site

```{r, fig.height = 7, fig.width =11}
fig_data <- analysis_data %>%
  select(subject, siteshort_n, n_site, arm_c, starts_with("yn_eortc")) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("yn_eortc"),
               names_to = "time",
               names_prefix = "yn_eortc_",
               values_to = "yn_eortc") %>%
  mutate_at(vars(starts_with("yn_eortc")), ~replace_na(.,0)) %>% 
  group_by(siteshort_n, time) %>% 
  mutate(n_visit = sum(yn_eortc)) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(p_visit = n_visit/n_site*100,
         time = factor(time, levels = paste0(seq(0, 12, 3))))

# line graph of survey completion per month by site
fig_data %>%
```
